passage.label: An-Nisa — Created from one soul; taqwa and kinship ties; orphans' wealth protection; marriage limits and mahr; do not give weak-minded your property; test orphans before handing over property

arabicExcerpts.text: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ ٱتَّقُواْ رَبَّكُمُ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَكُم مِّن نَّفۡسٖ وَٰحِدَةٖ وَخَلَقَ مِنۡهَا زَوۡجَهَا وَبَثَّ مِنۡهُمَا رِجَالٗا كَثِيرٗا وَنِسَآءٗۚ وَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِي تَسَآءَلُونَ بِهِۦ وَٱلۡأَرۡحَامَۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ رَقِيبٗا
وَءَاتُواْ ٱلۡيَتَٰمَىٰٓ أَمۡوَٰلَهُمۡۖ وَلَا تَتَبَدَّلُواْ ٱلۡخَبِيثَ بِٱلطَّيِّبِۖ وَلَا تَأۡكُلُوٓاْ أَمۡوَٰلَهُمۡ إِلَىٰٓ أَمۡوَٰلِكُمۡۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ حُوبٗا كَبِيرٗا

وَإِنۡ خِفۡتُمۡ أَلَّا تُقۡسِطُواْ فِي ٱلۡيَتَٰمَىٰ فَٱنكِحُواْ مَا طَابَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلنِّسَآءِ مَثۡنَىٰ وَثُلَٰثَ وَرُبَٰعَۖ فَإِنۡ خِفۡتُمۡ أَلَّا تَعۡدِلُواْ فَوَٰحِدَةً أَوۡ مَا مَلَكَتۡ أَيۡمَٰنُكُمۡۚ ذَٰلِكَ أَدۡنَىٰٓ أَلَّا تَعُولُواْ
وَءَاتُواْ ٱلنِّسَآءَ صَدُقَٰتِهِنَّ نِحۡلَةٗۚ فَإِن طِبۡنَ لَكُمۡ عَن شَيۡءٖ مِّنۡهُ نَفۡسٗا فَكُلُوهُ هَنِيٓـٔٗا مَّرِيٓـٔٗا
وَلَا تُؤۡتُواْ ٱلسُّفَهَآءَ أَمۡوَٰلَكُمُ ٱلَّتِي جَعَلَ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمۡ قِيَٰمٗا وَٱرۡزُقُوهُمۡ فِيهَا وَٱكۡسُوهُمۡ وَقُولُواْ لَهُمۡ قَوۡلٗا مَّعۡرُوفٗا

وَٱبۡتَلُواْ ٱلۡيَتَٰمَىٰ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا بَلَغُواْ ٱلنِّكَاحَ فَإِنۡ ءَانَسۡتُم مِّنۡهُمۡ رُشۡدٗا فَٱدۡفَعُوٓاْ إِلَيۡهِمۡ أَمۡوَٰلَهُمۡۖ وَلَا تَأۡكُلُوهَآ إِسۡرَافٗا وَبِدَارًا أَن يَكۡبَرُواْۚ وَمَن كَانَ غَنِيّٗا فَلۡيَسۡتَعۡفِفۡۖ وَمَن كَانَ فَقِيرٗا فَلۡيَأۡكُلۡ بِٱلۡمَعۡرُوفِۚ فَإِذَا دَفَعۡتُمۡ إِلَيۡهِمۡ أَمۡوَٰلَهُمۡ فَأَشۡهِدُواْ عَلَيۡهِمۡۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ حَسِيبٗا

mainSubject.label: Humanity's origin from a single soul (nafsin wahidah) and its mate; command to fear Allah through whom mutual rights are asked and to respect kinship ties (arham); giving orphans their properties without substitution; marrying women with mahr given graciously; prohibition of giving property to the weak-minded; testing orphans until marriageable age before returning their wealth; witnesses required at handover

subordinateSubjects.label: Creation from one soul and its mate
Taqwa of Allah and arham (kinship ties)
Prohibition of substituting bad for good
Consuming orphan wealth into own wealth is great sin (huban kabiran)
Marriage limits: two, three, four; or one if justice feared
Giving women their saduqat (bridal gifts) as nihlah (gracious gift)
Women may willingly remit part of mahr
Do not give property to weak-minded (sufaha')
Provide and clothe them, speak kindly
If rushd perceived, hand over their wealth
Do not consume it extravagantly or hastily
Guardian who is rich should abstain; poor may take reasonably
Witnesses required when returning orphan wealth

humanConditionsAndSpiritualStates.label: Human weakness: created from single soul, dispersed widely

socialEconomicCivilisational.label: Orphan wealth protection as foundational economic justice
Mahr system establishing financial rights of women in marriage

relationships.label: Kinship ties (arham) as sacred obligation alongside taqwa

notes: Pass A Nisa passage 1/4. Opens Surah An-Nisa with universal human origin narrative (nafsin wahidah), grounding all subsequent legislation in shared humanity. Orphan wealth protection dominates vv.2,5,6 forming an inclusio around marriage/mahr (vv.3-4). Testing orphans (ibtaloo) before property transfer introduces developmental readiness concept.
